title: Add scoped R439 quartet frame-cut audit
body:
## Summary

Adds a scoped audit of one chronological cut in Sagar Thakrar's merged PR #1045 R439 four-helper word. The seed-7 winner uses helper labels `269, 88, 288, 153` and preparation `a ^= b; c ^= d; b ^= c`.

At the first compiled middle injection (D index 506), the four mixed helpers remain in frame 0. None is written after the three-gate mix at D indices 114–116, and all four feed the middle injection. The exact helper map is `[3,14,12,8]`; reversing the three gates restores the four helper coordinates after target cleanup.

A within-frame control swaps the dependent second and third gates. It remains frame-available but changes the local dirty-input boundary for helper 153 alone: the target difference is supported at indices `3,17,34,38,46,50,55,60,77,83,94`. This confirms that chronological order carries semantic information in this instance.

## Scope

This is one finite cut audit. It does not complete a replacement for H2/K, rerun the predecessor's all-661-column verifier, recompute the paid profile, or claim supplier adoption or a new κ. The predecessor's syntactic `H2_D_frame0_targets_from_helpers` and `K_equals_D` flags remain false.

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-quartet-frame-cut-homelab02
```

Expected result:

```text
PASS_R439_QUARTET_FRAME_CUT prep=114:117 injection=506 helpers_frame0=true helper_reads=9,11,8,15 local_inputs=16 reorder_failures=8 reorder_witness=153 delta_support=3,17,34,38,46,50,55,60,77,83,94 no_supplier_claim
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/r439-quartet-frame-cut-homelab02 outcome=partial
```

## Source and credit

The audit pins the predecessor's 43-file source closure plus its certificate and constructor. It was prepared by Codex agent `homelab-02` with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. PR #1045's PR941 matching, PR915 target basis, and earlier PR915/926/941 and PR555/589 credits remain in the package.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-quartet-frame-cut-homelab02` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/r439-quartet-frame-cut-homelab02 --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.

## CI update

This PR includes two shared CI repairs. The packed central-factor historical audit now runs with the exact source files from its pinned commit and the adapter from this checkout; the audit and normal/optimized test suites passed locally against that snapshot. The PR reconciliation check now treats `closure` as optional only for decision rows that omit it, while keeping the other fields required; the family projection comparison passed for 2,947 rows, including 24 closure-free entries. GitHub CI is rerunning for this head.


### CI update: historical documentation source inventory

The historical tooling-ledger replay rejected the current live digest of `docs/ci-verification.md`, although its immutable snapshot still matched the original source pin. The current text consists of the already accepted replay-guidance update plus the later timeout-guidance documentation (`54bbb81`); I added the current digest to the live-successor allowlist without changing the historical snapshot pin.

Local validation passed for the affected authenticated input: original snapshot SHA-256 `a854022e…9c4b0` remains intact and live digest `a3711fe1…911bc` is accepted; Python compilation and `git diff --check` also pass. Full `tooling-ledger` replay could not run in the sparse local worktree because unrelated manifest inputs are absent; rerun is pending on GitHub CI.
